settings_panel.title: Settings
settings_panel.general.title: General Settings
settings_panel.general.language.label: Interface Language

settings_panel.themes.title: Theme Settings
settings_panel.themes.theme_selection.de: Enter a direct image URL to use as the application's background image.
settings_panel.themes.background_image_o: Set the opacity of the background image, ranging from 0 (fully transparent) to 1 (fully opaque).
settings_panel.themes.background_image_b: Set the blur level of the background image.

settings_panel.define_gen.title: Definition Generator Settings
settings_panel.define_gen.indent.label: Default Indent Size
settings_panel.define_gen.indent.descrip: Set the number of spaces to use for indentation in the generated structure definitions. Default is 2. This setting may be overridden by certain generators.
settings_panel.define_gen.only_types.des: When enabled, the generator will only produce type definitions without the parsing functions. This is useful for scenarios that require pure type information.
settings_panel.define_gen.all_as_optiona: When enabled, the generator will set all properties as optional. This is useful for scenarios that involve handling potentially missing data.
